productArea.name: Milestones
productArea.scope: Search, filter, sort, create, edit, and close milestones across global, organization, and repository lists, including due dates, detail lists, and issue or pull request assignment. Editing the assigned issues and pull requests is outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Milestones in the global navigation and use its filters.
Choose Issues then Milestones in the seeded repository, and create or open a milestone for its due date, state, and assigned items.
Open an organization you can access, then its Milestones dashboard and team filters. Create a disposable organization if none exists.
